app.ended.title: Chat over
app.ended.left: You left. The room stays open for the other person until they leave too.
app.ended.left.host: You left, which ended the chat for everyone. You are hosting, so the room cannot stay open without you.
app.ended.byPeer: {name} ended the chat. The room and its code are gone.
landing.title: Translated video chat
landing.sub: Two people, two languages. You each read the other in your own, live, while you talk.
landing.codeHint: That does not look like a room code. You can paste the whole link instead.
auth.sub: You need an account to start or join a chat.
auth.displayName.hint: Shown to the people you talk to. You can still pick a different name for each chat.
auth.invite.hint: Ask the person who runs this app for one.
auth.switch.toSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.error.INVALID_INPUT: Check the email address and fill in every field.
auth.error.WEAK_PASSWORD: That password is too short. Use at least {min} characters.
auth.error.INVITE_INVALID: That invite code does not work. It may have been used already, or it has expired.
auth.error.EMAIL_TAKEN: There is already an account with that email. Sign in instead.
auth.error.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password do not match an account.
auth.error.LOCKED: Too many attempts for this account. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
auth.error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts from here. Wait a minute, then try again.
account.invite.lead: Send this code to the person you are inviting. It works once, for 7 days.
account.invite.failed: Could not create an invite. Try again.
account.delete.title: Delete your account
account.delete.lead: This deletes your account, your saved language, your saved glossary and your call history. It cannot be undone. The people you talked to keep their own record of each call, without your name on it.
account.delete.expired: Your session had expired. Try again.
account.delete.changed: This tab is now signed in to another account. Nothing was deleted.
auth.error.unavailable: Could not reach the server. Try again.
prejoin.sub.create: You will get a code to send to one other person.
prejoin.stt.cloud: Speech recognition on this browser sends your audio to your browser vendor for transcription. The call itself stays encrypted between the two of you.
prejoin.stt.onDevice: On device speech recognition is available. Your audio will not leave this machine.
prejoin.name.label: Your name, just for this chat
prejoin.dialect.label: Your language and region
prejoin.video: Turn my camera on. Audio is required either way.
prejoin.glossary.load: Load corrections from a past chat
prejoin.glossary.loaded.one: Loaded 1 correction from your last chat.
prejoin.glossary.loaded.many: Loaded {count} corrections from your last chat.
room.invite.lead: Send this code to one other person
room.dialect.label: Your language and region
room.dialect.title: Change this if the translation is not coming out in the right regional Spanish
room.translation.mootTitle: You both speak the same language, so nothing is being translated.
room.translation.title: Stops translating what the other person says, for you only. They still get your words translated.
room.end.title: End this chat for everyone?
room.end.body: This closes the room for both of you and kills the code permanently. Nobody can rejoin, including you. Download the transcript first if you want to keep it.
room.end.alt.before: To step out and leave the room open for the other person, use
room.end.host.note: You are hosting this chat, so leaving it ends it for the other person too.
room.settings.title: Settings
chips.muted.titleNoName: The other person muted their microphone, so nothing they say is transcribed.
chips.muted.title: {name} muted their microphone, so nothing they say is transcribed.
chips.translationOff.title: They are reading your words untranslated, so your lines stop showing a translation. What they say is still translated for you.
chips.translationUnavailable.stillWorks: The call, the transcript, and the original subtitles all keep working.
chips.reconnecting.title: The connection dropped. Retrying.
chips.peerDropped.title: Their connection dropped. They have a minute to come back.
chips.noMedia.title: The direct media connection could not be established, which usually means a restrictive network. Subtitles and chat still work.
chips.onDevice.title: Your audio is not leaving this machine. Recognition is less accurate than the cloud engine, especially on fast speech. Click to switch.
chips.cloud.title: Audio is going to the browser's cloud recognizer, which is more accurate but restarts roughly once a minute. Click to switch.
panel.title: Conversation
panel.export.json: Includes your corrections, so you can load them next time
panel.empty: Nothing yet. Say something, or type below.
correct.title: Fix this translation
correct.body: Your correction applies right away, and it is remembered for the rest of this chat. It also travels in the .json download, so you can load it at the start of your next one.
overlay.empty: Whatever you both say appears here, translated.
export.glossary: Corrections you made, carried in the .json file for next time:
import.notJson: That file is not valid JSON. Use a .json export, not the .txt.
import.notExport: That file does not look like a transcript export.
import.tooNew: That file was made by a newer version of this app and cannot be read here.
import.noGlossary: That export has no corrections saved in it.
import.noUsable: That export has no usable corrections in it.
media.insecure.microphone: This page needs a secure connection to use your microphone. Open it over https, or from localhost. An address like http://192.168.1.5 will not work.
media.insecure.camera: This page needs a secure connection to use your camera. Open it over https, or from localhost. An address like http://192.168.1.5 will not work.
media.unsupported: This browser cannot access media devices.
media.denied.microphone: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in your browser's site settings, then reload this page.
media.denied.camera: Camera access was blocked. Allow it in your browser's site settings, then try again.
media.noDevice.microphone: No microphone was found. Connect one and reload.
media.noDevice.camera: No camera was found. Connect one and try again.
media.inUse.microphone: Your microphone is in use by another app. Close it and reload.
media.inUse.camera: Your camera is in use by another app. Close it and try again.
stt.none: This browser has no speech recognition. The call and text chat still work, but live subtitles do not. Chrome, Edge, or Safari will show subtitles.
stt.unsupported: This browser cannot do speech recognition.
stt.noMicrophone: No microphone is available. Check that one is connected and not in use.
stt.permission: Speech recognition was denied. That is a separate permission from the microphone, which is why the call still works and only the subtitles are missing. On iPhone and iPad it lives in Settings, under Privacy and Security, then Speech Recognition. In a desktop browser, allow it in this site's permissions. Then reload the page.
stt.languageUnsupported: That language is not supported for speech recognition.
stt.keepsDropping: Subtitles keep dropping. Reload the page, or continue without them.
error.ROOM_NOT_FOUND: No chat with that code. Check it, or ask for a new one.
error.ROOM_FULL: That chat already has two people in it.
error.ROOM_ENDED: That chat was ended and cannot be rejoined.
error.BAD_CODE: That does not look like a room code.
error.INVALID_RESUME: Your seat could not be restored. Join again with the code.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts from here. Wait a minute, then try again.
error.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: That was too long to send. Shorten it and try again.
error.MALFORMED: This page sent something the server could not read. Reload the page.
error.NOT_IN_ROOM: You are not in a chat any more. Join again with the code.
error.ALREADY_IN_ROOM: This tab is already in a chat. Leave that one before joining another.
error.HOST_NOT_PRESENT: That chat has not started yet, or the person hosting it has left. Ask them to start it, then try again.
error.UNAUTHENTICATED: Sign in first, then try again.
failure.NOT_CONFIGURED: Translation is not set up on this server, so lines stay in the language they were said in.
failure.PROVIDER_REJECTED: The translation service refused this server, so translation is off. The call and the transcript still work.
failure.TOO_MANY_IN_FLIGHT: Too many translations at once. Try this line again in a moment.
failure.DAILY_CAP: Today's translation budget is spent, so nothing more is being translated.
failure.ROOM_CAP: This chat has used up its translation budget, so nothing more is being translated.
failure.USER_CAP: The person hosting this chat has used up their translation budget for today, so nothing more is being translated.
failure.LEDGER_UNREADABLE: The spend record cannot be read, so this server refuses to translate rather than spend untracked.
failure.LEDGER_UNWRITABLE: The spend record cannot be written, so this server stopped translating rather than spend untracked.
failure.UNRESOLVED_DIALECT: A language in this call is not one this server recognizes. Pick your language again from the list.
failure.EMPTY_RESULT: The translator came back with nothing. Try this line again.
failure.TIMED_OUT: Translating took too long. Try this line again.
failure.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED: The translation service is holding this server back. Try this line again in a moment.
failure.PROVIDER_ERROR: Translating failed. Try this line again.
